gilberto-oliva--gilberto-oliva-reserva.description: Named for the Oliva family patriarch, this Nicaraguan-made line from Oliva Cigar Co. pairs aged Nicaraguan filler with an Ecuadorian binder under a Sumatra wrapper. It sits around medium and is gentler than the fuller Oliva blends, with cedar, earth and nuts, a restrained pepper and a soft, creamy chocolate sweetness.

thirds.notes: Earthy spice and pepper with cedar and a creamy, malty note.
Creamier, with honey-like sweetness, baking spices such as ginger and cinnamon, and cedar.
Black pepper and charred oak with earthy cocoa, cream and a butterscotch-like sweetness as the body builds.

gilberto-oliva--gilberto-oliva-reserva-b.description: The lighter version of Oliva's Gilberto Oliva Reserva, made in Nicaragua with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over an Ecuadorian binder and Nicaraguan long filler. Mild to medium in strength with a medium body, it shows nuts and gentle spice before a smooth, creamy finish, suited to a morning or daytime smoke.

thirds.notes: Cedar leads with pecan and a creamy feel, toasty bread on the retrohale and some earth.
The pecan fades for a soft caramel note over cedar and earth, with a toasty finish.
Caramel sweetness stays, pecan returns faintly and a first hint of pepper reaches the retrohale.
